notes.title: Update 4
notes.notes: In version 1.2, we fixed a bug with magic. When you could create one force several times. Also fixed a bug with a survival button. When she was always active. The darkest levels have become more vivid. The problem with achievements has not been eliminated.

notes.title: Update 3
notes.notes: In this update, we come out with early access. In the new version of the game, we added 3 part of the storyline, a new survival map, new units, quest hero and support for in-game achievements.

notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes:
In this update, we: 
• added a new tower and magic power: tower of death and powder bomb
• Changed the appearance of the main menu
• Fixed a system of magic.Now the magic icon will disappear only when magic is activated.
• Fixed a bug with invisibility of text in the main menu in the section of settings.
